      "rationale": "Does not affect the kernel API boundary or design; only strips parameters for the removed validation feature."
    },
    {

    },

      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing loadtxoutset merely reflects the elimination of the underlying validation capability rather than an RPC subsystem change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

      "rationale": "Test deletions pin the removed validation feature rather than testing framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds startup checks in src/init.cpp rejecting incomplete snapshot datadirs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup edits are domain-specific validation error handling rather than utility or logging infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Consolidates ChainstateManager and BlockManager to a single chainstate, removing AssumeUTXO snapshot loading and background validation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes a significant recurring architectural burden by eliminating concurrent chainstates. As noted in the description, 'ordinary validation changes have to account for different chainstate roles, candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks', offering substantial and durable maintainability gains across validation."
    },

    }
